title: The Uncharted Passage
author: E. M. Coldharbour
blurb: Juniper Halloran, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
